description: Hooks for analytics-skills. Provides automated nudges for SQL and notebook edits.

hooks.command: echo '[analytics-skills] SQL edited — consider invoking agents/sql-reviewer.md or skills/modular-sql-ctes/ for structure review.' >&2

PostToolUse.matcher: tool == "Edit" && tool_input.file_path matches "\\.(ipynb|py)$" && tool_input.new_string matches "(?i)(p_value|p-value|significance|confidence interval|ab[ _]test)"

hooks.command: echo '[analytics-skills] Statistical analysis detected — consider skills/ab-test-analysis/ for review checklist and skills/stakeholder-readout/ for output structure.' >&2
echo '[analytics-skills] SELECT * detected — see rules/snowflake-sql-style.md (avoid select * outside staging).' >&2

PostToolUse.matcher: tool == "Write" && tool_input.file_path matches "\\.sql$" && tool_input.contents matches "\\bjoin\\b" && !(tool_input.contents matches "\\b(inner|left|right|full|cross)\\s+join\\b")

hooks.command: echo '[analytics-skills] Bare JOIN keyword detected — always specify join type (inner/left/full). See rules/snowflake-sql-style.md.' >&2
echo '[analytics-skills] dbt run starting — consider /dq-check on outputs after completion.' >&2
